title: Latent Jacobian Steer: Eliciting Contact-Rich Out-of-Distribution Behaviors from Pretrained Humanoid Controllers
abstract: arXiv:2611.27338v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given a pretrained general latent-conditioned whole-body humanoid controller, say a behavioral foundation model (BFM), how can we elicit complex and contact-rich out-of-distribution behaviors? Raw joint-action exploration enables direct, task-specific adjustments but can disrupt coordination learned by the pretrained controller, whereas latent exploration retains that coordination but is difficult to steer toward desired physical effects. To combine the complementary strengths of these exploration spaces, we propose Latent Jacobian Steer (LJS), which couples sampling in direct joint-action space with the semantics of the learned frozen controller's input latent space. For a task specified through desired physical effects, we sample task-relevant joint-action perturbations and map them through a damped local inverse of the policy Jacobian to obtain candidate latent ($z$) commands. translated_title: 潜在雅可比引导：从预训练人形控制器中引发富含接触的分布外行为
translated_abstract: 给定一个预训练的通用潜在条件全身人形控制器（例如行为基础模型 BFM），我们如何能够引发复杂且富含接触的分布外行为？原始关节动作探索能够实现直接的、特定任务的调整，但可能会破坏预训练控制器学到的协调性；而潜在空间探索保留了这种协调性，但难以引导至期望的物理效果。为了结合这两种探索空间的互补优势，我们提出了潜在雅可比引导（Latent Jacobian Steer, LJS），该方法将直接关节动作空间中的采样与所学习的冻结控制器输入潜在空间的语义相耦合。对于通过期望物理效果指定的任务，我们采样与任务相关的关节动作扰动，并通过策略雅可比的阻尼局部逆映射，将其映射为候选潜在（z）指令。这些指令通过冻结的预训练控制器执行……
tldr: 提出潜在雅可比引导（LJS）方法，通过将关节动作空间采样与策略雅可比的阻尼局部逆映射相结合，从预训练人形控制器中引发复杂且富含接触的分布外行为，兼顾了协调性与任务针对性。
en_tdlr: We propose Latent Jacobian Steer (LJS), which couples task-relevant joint-action sampling with a damped local inverse of the policy Jacobian to obtain latent commands, enabling elicitation of complex, contact-rich out-of-distribution behaviors from pretrained humanoid controllers.
